issue: Form fields with required=False drop the model default when the widget returns an empty value. A cleaned empty value should fall back to the field's configured default instead of None.

dependencyMemories.body: Form field defaults are resolved in BoundField.value(), not in Field.clean(); to change default fallback behavior, patch value resolution in BoundField.value(), not the field cleaners.

distractorMemories.body: The ORM query cache is keyed on the SQL string; invalidate it on schema changes.
Template autoescaping is toggled per-block, not globally.
Middleware ordering matters: SessionMiddleware must precede AuthenticationMiddleware.
Prefer select_related for FK access in list views to avoid N+1 queries.
